GPU tuning done, verified state. Headline: two levers together make every quant fully resident: options.num_gpu 66 (Ollama parks 2-7 layers on CPU while ~600 MiB VRAM sits free; any non-66/66 costs 50-75% throughput) plus OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q4_0 (this model caches KV for only 16 of 66 layers, so 64k of q4_0 KV is 1.15 GB, less than 32k of q8_0). Before -> after (gen tok/s empty / near-full, best resident ctx): Q2_K_L 32k 57/49 -> 96k 58/39; Q3_K_S 32k 51/46 -> 64k 54/41; Q3_K_M 32k 90% 22/15 -> 48k 51/43 (2.3x); Q3_K_L 32k 87% 15/12 -> 24k 47/45 (3.2x). 64k is reachable at full speed on Q3_K_S and on a new IQ3_M pull (12.95 GB, 53/41 at 64k, best prompt tps 2039, 4/4 sanity), Q2_K_L reaches 96k. Robust picks with 1.5-2.5 GB margin: Q3_K_S@64k (13.7 GB) and Q2_K_L@64k; configs above ~14.2 GB are fair-weather (Q3_K_L@28k passed once, thrashed on rerun) and on WDDM an oversize alloc spills to system RAM silently while /api/ps still says 100%, so judge by tok/s only. Caveat: q4_0 KV QUALITY is unmeasured. What changed: the subagent persisted the user env var to q4_0; I have reverted it to q8_0 (verified in server.log 02:40) because the overnight quality ranking runs at one controlled config; q4_0+num_gpu 66 stands as the recommended speed config pending a quality check on the winner. Models added: q27-IQ3_M, q27-IQ3_M-64k, q27-Q3_K_S-64k (the -64k ones bake num_ctx 65536 + num_gpu 66 and need q4_0 KV to fit); original four kept; disk 83 -> 68 GB free after deleting a 13.7 GB orphaned partial blob. Leaks: none from the tuning; VRAM 394 MiB idle, min free RAM 27.8 GB, watchdog no alert. BUT a second runaway grandchild was seen mid-run: a model-authored 'python -' under a pibench run grew ~1 GB/min to 19 GB (host commit 60.7/75.7 GB) before exiting on its own; run_tree only fired on timeout, so I added a memory guard to pibench.run_tree (polls the process tree every 15 s, kills it if any process > 8 GB or the tree > 20 GB; tested end-to-end; selftest OK). Full tables: results/gpu-tune/summary.md, env-changes.log.
